---
title: "Output API"
toc-depth: 3
---

A plot compiles to a Vega-Lite specification, which it returns as an array or JSON, embeds in HTML, or exports to SVG, PNG, or PDF through vl-convert. The escape hatches add raw Vega-Lite where phiz has no method. [Rendering](rendering.qmd) covers the options for each output.
